name: Viking Therapeutics, Inc.
why: Unconfirmed buyout and partnership rumors, including speculation about Novo Nordisk and other pharma buyers, have fueled volatile trading; many traders remain skeptical and say previous rumor-driven pops have faded without a confirmed deal. Discussion also centers on VK2735s ObesityWeek data, including reported improvements in BMI category and cardiometabolic measures, while the Phase 3 readouts remain a key milestone.

name: Helus Pharma Inc.
why: Helus Pharmas Phase 3 APPROACH study of HLP003 met its primary and key secondary endpoints in major depression, with benefits reported from Day 2 through Week 12. Traders are surprised by the sharp, volatile selloff despite the positive data, debating a sell-the-news reaction and dilution risk against concerns about three treatment-related serious adverse events and enthusiasm for the trial results.

name: Aragon
why: Most of the attention reflects ticker confusion: traders are using $ANT.X to discuss Anthropics IPO, even though this symbol is Aragons crypto token. Aragon-specific posts instead mention the projects dissolution, the end of its token-redemption initiative, and concerns about the token being removed from an exchange.

name: Bitcoin
why: Bitcoins sharp selloff and volatile rebound amid forced liquidations and broader risk-off sentiment dominate discussion. Traders are split between warnings of further declines and calls that the dip is oversold and worth buying.

name: DESTINY TECH 100 INC
why: DXYZ is drawing attention as a listed fund with exposure to Anthropic, whose IPO is the dominant catalyst in the discussion. Traders are split between expecting the offering to boost DXYZs perceived portfolio value and worrying that weak price action, its discount to reported NAV, or a sell-the-news reaction could outweigh the catalyst.

name: Ethereum
why: A sharp, market-wide crypto selloff and reports of leveraged positions being liquidated dominate Ethereum discussion. Traders debate whether the drop is a buying opportunity or further downside, with some speculating that investors are shifting cash toward Anthropics IPO.

name: Internet Computer
why: ICPs recent rebound has sparked breakout and continuation chatter, with bulls pointing to its decentralized cloud, AI infrastructure and Cloud Engines thesis. Skeptics counter that adoption and revenue remain limited and the token has struggled to sustain gains.

name: XPeng Inc.
why: XPengs quarterly results and strong fourth-quarter outlook are driving attention, with traders highlighting record revenue and deliveries while debating whether the growth can translate into sustained profitability.
